 Jennifer Lawrence shares throwback with Josh Hutcherson, Liam Hemsworth
 Lawrence and Hutcherson are set to reprise their roles on 'Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping'
 By 
 Web Desk 
 | 
 Published November 17, 2026 
 Jennifer Lawrence is feeling the Hunger Games nostalgia just as much as the fans.
 With fresh faces taking over the franchise in the upcoming prequel, Sunrise on the Reaping , the OG star shared an Instagram throwback featuring her alongside co-stars Josh Hutcherson and Liam Hemsworth. The trio famously played Katniss Everdeen, Peeta Mellark and Gale Hawthorne in the original 2012 film and its two sequels.
 “Girls just wanna have fun,” the Oscar-winning actress captioned one photo showing them at the airport. 
 READ MORE: 'Hunger Games' breaks internet with huge surprise leading to release 
 Two more snaps featured the trio inside what appeared to be a private jet and posing at a scenic location.
 Lawrence and Hutcherson, along with Haymitch Abernathy actor Woody Harrelson, are set to make cameo appearances in the prequel, reprising their respective roles. The three stars attended the film's New York premiere on Monday, November 16, where they met the new cast, including Joseph Zada as a young Haymitch, Mckenna Grace as Maysilee Donner, Elle Fanning as young Effie Trinket, and more. 
 “I think they’re not gonna be disappointed,” Lawrence said of the movie. “We saw it, it was so great. It’s terrific. Joseph Zada is amazing.” 
 “The whole cast is amazing,” Hutcherson added. “The story is heartbreaking, it’s beautiful, triumphant in ways,” 
 “Truly funny— I’m just kidding,” Lawrence joked as Hutcherson played along. “It’s hilarious. I love the rom-com twist. And like the claymation element,” he said. 
 Of course, fans of the Suzanne Collins novels would know the tragic backstory of Haymitch and Maysilee — and that’s all we’ll say without giving away any spoilers.
